ports.name: clk_i
ports.functionality: Provides rising-edge timing for the control register updates and supplies clock to the instantiated cache memory. Drives sequential updates in ctrl_engine_sync and clocks the neorv32_cache_memory instance.
ports.evidence: process ctrl_engine_sync uses rising_edge(clk_i); instance port map clk_i => clk_i

ports.name: rstn_i
ports.functionality: Asynchronous active-low reset that forces ctrl fields to defined defaults and also feeds reset to the instantiated cache memory. Overrides normal updates on reset and resets the memory instance.
ports.evidence: process ctrl_engine_sync sensitivity and reset branch if (rstn_i = '0') assigns ctrl fields; instance port map rstn_i => rstn_i

ports.name: host_req_i
ports.functionality: Supplies the whole host request record to combinational control: it is copied to bus_req_o, used to form cache outputs and to drive state decisions (stb,fence,rw and addr-based checks).
ports.evidence: ctrl_engine_comb copies bus_req_o <= host_req_i; uses host_req_i.stb/fence/rw/address in conditions; cache_o.addr <= host_req_i.addr

ports.name: host_req_i.addr
ports.functionality: Provides address bits used to populate cache_o.addr and to derive ctrl_nxt.tag and ctrl_nxt.idx; also compared to UC_BEGIN to decide direct handling (buf_dir).
ports.evidence: cache_o.addr <= host_req_i.addr; ctrl_nxt.tag/idx <= host_req_i.addr(...) in S_LOOKUP; comparison unsigned(host_req_i.addr(31 downto 28)) >= unsigned(UC_BEGIN)

ports.name: host_req_i.data
ports.functionality: Supplies write data to cache outputs and is carried into bus requests; used when write operations are propagated to cache or bus.
ports.evidence: cache_o.data <= host_req_i.data; initial bus_req_o <= host_req_i copies data field

ports.name: host_req_i.ben
ports.functionality: Provides write byte-enable signals; copied into bus requests and used to set cache_o.we on host write paths.
ports.evidence: cache_o.we <= host_req_i.ben in S_LOOKUP write path; bus_req_o <= host_req_i initial copy

ports.name: host_req_i.stb
ports.functionality: Indicates an active host request; it enters combinational logic to set buf_req and to trigger state transitions from IDLE into lookup/download flows.
ports.evidence: ctrl_nxt.buf_req <= ctrl.buf_req or host_req_i.stb; S_IDLE checks host_req_i.stb to move to S_LOOKUP

ports.name: host_req_i.rw
ports.functionality: Controls read vs write handling in combinational control: it gates whether a host request can be served from cache or must generate bus transactions, and is passed to bus_req_o.
ports.evidence: S_LOOKUP uses host_req_i.rw to choose responses; bus_req_o <= host_req_i initial copy

ports.name: host_req_i.src
ports.functionality: Is part of the host request record copied into the outgoing bus request; not used in control decisions in this source.
ports.evidence: bus_req_o <= host_req_i at start of ctrl_engine_comb

ports.name: host_req_i.priv
ports.functionality: Is part of the host request record passed through to bus_req_o; not used in combinational control here.
ports.evidence: bus_req_o <= host_req_i at start of ctrl_engine_comb

ports.name: host_req_i.debug
ports.functionality: Participates in the direct-mode decision: if debug is set the request is forced into direct mode (buf_dir). It is otherwise passed through in the bus request copy.
ports.evidence: S_IDLE compares host_req_i.debug to set ctrl_nxt.buf_dir; bus_req_o <= host_req_i copy

ports.name: host_req_i.amo
ports.functionality: Used to force direct handling of certain host requests (sets buf_dir) and otherwise flows into bus_req_o when copying the request.
ports.evidence: S_IDLE includes host_req_i.amo in condition setting ctrl_nxt.buf_dir; bus_req_o <= host_req_i

ports.name: host_req_i.amoop
ports.functionality: Is part of the host request record copied into bus_req_o; not operated on by control logic here.
ports.evidence: bus_req_o <= host_req_i initial copy in ctrl_engine_comb

ports.name: host_req_i.lock
ports.functionality: Is passed through into bus_req_o and also set explicitly in download sequences; host lock may be overwritten by state assignments.
ports.evidence: bus_req_o <= host_req_i copy; S_DOWNLOAD_REQ/S_DOWNLOAD_RSP set bus_req_o.lock <= '1'

ports.name: host_req_i.fence
ports.functionality: Either sets buf_sync (buffered sync) or triggers immediate clear state; it gates the controller's transition into S_CLEAR and is carried into bus_req_o if not overridden.
ports.evidence: ctrl_nxt.buf_sync <= ctrl.buf_sync or host_req_i.fence; S_IDLE checks host_req_i.fence to go to S_CLEAR; bus_req_o <= host_req_i

ports.name: host_rsp_o
ports.functionality: Reports responses back to the host: its fields are driven from cache data by default or forwarded from bus_rsp_i during direct responses; ack/err may be set on download completion.
ports.evidence: host_rsp_o.data <= cache_i.data default; host_rsp_o <= bus_rsp_i in S_DIRECT_RSP; S_DOWNLOAD_DONE assigns host_rsp_o.ack/err

ports.name: host_rsp_o.ack
ports.functionality: Indicates a completed response to the host; it is driven from bus_rsp_i during direct responses and asserted on download completion when buf_err is set.
role: driven by bus responses and download status
ports.evidence: host_rsp_o <= bus_rsp_i in S_DIRECT_RSP; S_DOWNLOAD_DONE sets host_rsp_o.ack <= '1' when ctrl.buf_err = '1'

ports.name: host_rsp_o.err
ports.functionality: Signals an error to the host; default cleared, forwarded from bus_rsp_i on direct responses and asserted together with ack on download error.
ports.evidence: host_rsp_o <= bus_rsp_i in S_DIRECT_RSP; S_DOWNLOAD_DONE sets host_rsp_o.err <= '1' when ctrl.buf_err = '1'

ports.name: host_rsp_o.data
ports.functionality: Carries read data to the host; by default driven from cache_i.data and overridden by bus_rsp_i when forwarding direct bus responses.
ports.evidence: host_rsp_o.data <= cache_i.data default; host_rsp_o <= bus_rsp_i in S_DIRECT_RSP

ports.name: bus_req_o
ports.functionality: Sends requests to the external bus: it is initialized from host_req_i then modified in state branches (stb, fence, addr, rw, lock) to start direct or download transactions.
ports.evidence: bus_req_o <= host_req_i initial copy; S_DOWNLOAD_REQ/S_DOWNLOAD_RSP set bus_req_o.addr/rw/stb/lock/fence

ports.name: bus_req_o.addr
ports.functionality: Carries the address for outgoing bus transactions; normally copied from host_req_i.addr but overwritten with ctrl.tag/idx/ofs when performing downloads.
ports.evidence: bus_req_o <= host_req_i copy; S_DOWNLOAD_REQ assigns bus_req_o.addr <= ctrl.tag & ctrl.idx & ctrl.ofs & "00"

ports.name: bus_req_o.data
ports.functionality: Transmits write data on bus requests; by default carried from host_req_i.data and used in download/write sequences when bus transaction is issued.
ports.evidence: bus_req_o <= host_req_i initial copy; bus transactions use bus_req_o.data

ports.name: bus_req_o.ben
ports.functionality: Carries write byte-enable to bus requests; defaulted from host_req_i.ben and used when issuing write transactions.
ports.evidence: bus_req_o <= host_req_i initial copy; cache write uses host_req_i.ben

ports.name: bus_req_o.stb
ports.functionality: Signals the start of a bus transaction; cleared by default and asserted in states that issue immediate bus requests (direct or download).
ports.evidence: bus_req_o.stb <= '0' default; set to '1' in S_LOOKUP, S_DOWNLOAD_REQ, S_DOWNLOAD_RSP when transactions are issued

ports.name: bus_req_o.rw
ports.functionality: Indicates read or write on the bus; default copied from host_req_i but set explicitly to read ('0') in download sequences.
ports.evidence: bus_req_o <= host_req_i initial copy; S_DOWNLOAD_REQ sets bus_req_o.rw <= '0'

ports.name: bus_req_o.src
ports.functionality: Passed through from the host request into the bus request record; not used directly in control decisions here.
ports.evidence: bus_req_o <= host_req_i initial copy in ctrl_engine_comb

ports.name: bus_req_o.priv
ports.functionality: Carried from the host request to the outgoing bus request; the controller does not otherwise act on it in this source.
ports.evidence: bus_req_o <= host_req_i at start of ctrl_engine_comb

ports.name: bus_req_o.debug
ports.functionality: Propagates the debug flag from the host to the bus request record; debug also participates in the direct handling decision earlier in control.
ports.evidence: bus_req_o <= host_req_i initial copy; host_req_i.debug used in S_IDLE condition

ports.name: bus_req_o.amo
ports.functionality: Passed to the bus request; AMO participates in the direct-mode decision at lookup time and is otherwise carried through to the bus.
ports.evidence: bus_req_o <= host_req_i; S_IDLE uses host_req_i.amo in buf_dir decision

ports.name: bus_req_o.amoop
ports.functionality: Is copied from the host request into the bus request; control does not transform it here.
ports.evidence: bus_req_o <= host_req_i copy in comb process

ports.name: bus_req_o.lock
ports.functionality: Signals locked transactions on the bus; defaulted from host_req_i but explicitly asserted during download request/response sequences.
ports.evidence: bus_req_o <= host_req_i; S_DOWNLOAD_REQ and S_DOWNLOAD_RSP set bus_req_o.lock <= '1'

ports.name: bus_req_o.fence
ports.functionality: Requests a fence on the bus when clearing cache; set in S_CLEAR when READ_ONLY = false, otherwise default copy from host_req_i.
ports.evidence: If READ_ONLY = false then S_CLEAR sets bus_req_o.fence <= '1'; bus_req_o <= host_req_i initial copy

ports.name: bus_rsp_i
ports.functionality: Provides bus responses to be forwarded to the host or used to write into cache memory; its fields drive host_rsp_o and cache_o.data and update controller state on ack/err.
role: drives host responses and cache writes
ports.evidence: host_rsp_o <= bus_rsp_i in S_DIRECT_RSP; S_DOWNLOAD_RSP assigns cache_o.data <= bus_rsp_i.data and ctrl_nxt.buf_err <= ctrl.buf_err or bus_rsp_i.err; conditions check bus_rsp_i.ack

ports.name: bus_rsp_i.ack
ports.functionality: Indicates a completed bus transaction and is consulted to move controller between states (e.g., finishing direct responses and download responses).
ports.evidence: S_DIRECT_RSP uses if (bus_rsp_i.ack = '1') then ctrl_nxt.state <= S_IDLE; S_DOWNLOAD_RSP advances ofs when bus_rsp_i.ack = '1'

ports.name: bus_rsp_i.err
ports.functionality: Signals an error from the bus; it is ORed into ctrl_nxt.buf_err during download responses and later influences download completion behaviour.
ports.evidence: S_DOWNLOAD_RSP: ctrl_nxt.buf_err <= ctrl.buf_err or bus_rsp_i.err

ports.name: bus_rsp_i.data
ports.functionality: Carries data returned from the bus into cache_o.data for downloads and can be forwarded to the host when direct-forwarding occurs.
ports.evidence: S_DOWNLOAD_RSP sets cache_o.data <= bus_rsp_i.data; host_rsp_o <= bus_rsp_i in S_DIRECT_RSP

ports.name: rstn_i
ports.functionality: Provides an active-low asynchronous reset that forces valid bits and the valid pipeline register to zero; it governs assignments in the status_memory process's reset branch.
ports.evidence: status_memory process if (rstn_i = '0') then valid_mem <= (others=>'0'); valid_mem_rd <= '0'.

ports.name: clk_i
ports.functionality: Clocks the status, tag and data memory processes; sequences updates to valid bits, tag storage, data byte memories and the read-data output on rising edges.
ports.evidence: Processes use rising_edge(clk_i) in status_memory, tag_memory and data_memory.

ports.name: clr_i
ports.functionality: When asserted at a clock edge clears the entire valid_mem vector to zeros; it gates the full-vector valid assignment in the status_memory process.
ports.evidence: status_memory: elsif (clr_i = '1') then valid_mem <= (others => '0').

ports.name: inv_i
ports.functionality: When asserted at a clock edge clears the indexed valid bit at acc_idx, gating the indexed write to valid_mem for single-line invalidation.
ports.evidence: status_memory: elsif (inv_i = '1') then valid_mem(to_integer(unsigned(acc_idx))) <= '0'.

ports.name: new_i
ports.functionality: When asserted at a clock edge sets the indexed valid bit and writes the tag_mem entry at acc_idx; it gates both valid and tag updates on fill events.
ports.evidence: status_memory and tag_memory use elsif (new_i = '1') then valid_mem(...) <= '1' and tag_mem(...) <= acc_tag.

ports.name: hit_o
ports.functionality: Outputs '1' when the selected valid bit is set and the stored tag equals the accessed tag; it reports the hit condition derived from valid_mem_rd, tag_mem_rd and acc_tag.
ports.evidence: Concurrent assignment: hit_o <= '1' when (valid_mem_rd = '1') and (tag_mem_rd = acc_tag) else '0'.

ports.name: addr_i
ports.functionality: Provides the 32-bit address whose slices produce acc_tag, acc_idx and acc_off; these derived fields drive memory indexing and tag comparisons.
ports.evidence: Concurrent assigns: acc_tag <= addr_i(...); acc_idx <= addr_i(...); acc_off <= addr_i(...).

ports.name: we_i
ports.functionality: Each bit gates the corresponding byte write into the data byte memory arrays during the clocked data_memory process; individual bits enable writes to data_mem_b0..b3.
role: GOVERNS byte writes to data memories
ports.evidence: data_memory: if (we_i(0)='1') then data_mem_b0(...) <= wdata_i(7 downto 0) etc.

ports.name: wdata_i
ports.functionality: Supplies 32-bit write data; its byte slices are captured into the respective data_mem_b arrays on enabled writes during the clocked data_memory process.
ports.evidence: data_memory assigns data_mem_b0 <= wdata_i(7 downto 0), b1 <= wdata_i(15 downto 8), etc.

ports.name: rdata_o
ports.functionality: Delivers the 32-bit read word assembled from the four byte memory arrays; each rdata_o slice is clocked from the corresponding data_mem_b array.
ports.evidence: data_memory: rdata_o(7 downto 0) <= data_mem_b0(...), etc., inside rising_edge(clk_i).

signals.name: cache_o
signals.function: cache memory command and I/O bundle
signals.functionality: Aggregate signal carrying cache memory control (clr,inv,new), address, data and write mask. It is driven by combinational control and connected to the cache memory instance ports.
signals.evidence: cache_o fields set in ctrl_engine_comb; port map connects cache_o.* to neorv32_cache_memory instance ports

signals.name: cache_o.cmd_clr
signals.functionality: Control signal asserted in S_CLEAR to request the cache memory to clear its contents; driven combinationally from the controller and routed to the memory instance clr_i port.
signals.evidence: S_CLEAR sets cache_o.cmd_clr <= '1'; port map clr_i => cache_o.cmd_clr

signals.name: cache_o.cmd_inv
signals.functionality: Asserted in S_DOWNLOAD_DONE on download error to invalidate the new line; driven in combinational control and mapped to the memory inv_i port.
signals.evidence: S_DOWNLOAD_DONE sets cache_o.cmd_inv <= '1' on ctrl.buf_err; port map inv_i => cache_o.cmd_inv

signals.name: cache_o.cmd_new
signals.functionality: Asserted during download sequences (S_DOWNLOAD_REQ) to start writing a new cache line; drives the memory new_i input and is combinationally assigned from ctrl values.
signals.evidence: S_DOWNLOAD_REQ sets cache_o.cmd_new <= '1'; port map new_i => cache_o.cmd_new

signals.name: cache_o.addr
signals.functionality: Carries the 32-bit address presented to the cache memory; driven either from host_req_i.addr by default or from ctrl.tag/idx/ofs during downloads, and connected to the instance addr_i.
role: sourced from host or ctrl during download
signals.evidence: cache_o.addr <= host_req_i.addr default; S_DOWNLOAD_REQ sets cache_o.addr <= ctrl.tag & ctrl.idx & ctrl.ofs & "00"; port map addr_i => cache_o.addr

signals.name: cache_o.data
signals.functionality: Carries write data to the cache memory instance; typically comes from host_req_i.data or from bus_rsp_i.data during downloads and maps to the memory wdata_i port.
role: used for host writes and downloads
signals.evidence: cache_o.data <= host_req_i.data default; S_DOWNLOAD_RSP sets cache_o.data <= bus_rsp_i.data; port map wdata_i => cache_o.data

signals.name: cache_o.we
signals.functionality: Byte write enables presented to the cache memory; default zero, set from host_req_i.ben on host writes and set to all ones during download responses, and routed to memory we_i.
role: driven by host writes and downloads
signals.evidence: cache_o.we <= (others => '0') default; S_LOOKUP sets cache_o.we <= host_req_i.ben for writes; S_DOWNLOAD_RSP sets cache_o.we <= (others=>'1'); port map we_i => cache_o.we

signals.name: cache_i
signals.function: cache memory status and read data bundle
signals.functionality: Aggregate input record from the cache memory instance providing hit status and read data. It is driven by the memory instance's outputs and read by controller combinational logic and fed to host_rsp_o.
role: supplies hit and data to control
signals.evidence: port map rdata_o => cache_i.data and hit_o => cache_i.sta_hit; cache_i used in ctrl_engine_comb to test sta_hit and supply host_rsp_o.data

signals.name: cache_i.sta_hit
signals.functionality: Indicates whether the requested address hits in the cache; driven by the memory instance and used in lookup state decisions to choose direct response, write-through, or download paths.
signals.evidence: S_LOOKUP tests if cache_i.sta_hit = '1' to choose responses; port map hit_o => cache_i.sta_hit

signals.name: cache_i.data
signals.functionality: Provides 32-bit read data from the cache memory instance to controller; used as default source for host response data and in lookup logic.
signals.evidence: host_rsp_o.data <= cache_i.data default; port map rdata_o => cache_i.data

signals.name: ctrl
signals.functionality: Register holding the current controller state, buffered request flags, error/dir flags and selected tag/index/offset; updated on clk_i from ctrl_nxt and initialized on reset.
signals.evidence: process ctrl_engine_sync assigns ctrl <= ctrl_nxt on rising_edge(clk_i); reset branch assigns ctrl.* when rstn_i = '0'

signals.name: ctrl.state
signals.functionality: Holds the current FSM state (S_IDLE, S_LOOKUP, ...); updated from ctrl_nxt in the clocked process and used to select control actions in the combinational engine.
signals.evidence: ctrl_engine_sync updates ctrl <= ctrl_nxt on rising_edge(clk_i); ctrl.state used in case statement in ctrl_engine_comb

signals.name: ctrl.buf_req
signals.functionality: Sticky flag that records an outstanding host request (set from host_req_i.stb) and held across cycles; cleared in combinational next-state logic when consumed.
signals.evidence: ctrl_engine_sync captures ctrl <= ctrl_nxt; ctrl_nxt.buf_req <= ctrl.buf_req or host_req_i.stb; S_IDLE tests ctrl.buf_req

signals.name: ctrl.buf_sync
signals.functionality: Sticky fence flag set by host_req_i.fence and cleared when a clear is performed; it can trigger S_CLEAR from idle and is stored across cycles.
signals.evidence: ctrl_engine_sync captures ctrl <= ctrl_nxt; ctrl_nxt.buf_sync <= ctrl.buf_sync or host_req_i.fence; S_IDLE checks ctrl.buf_sync

signals.name: ctrl.buf_err
signals.functionality: Records whether any bus error occurred during a multi-beat download; updated with bus_rsp_i.err during download responses and inspected on download completion.
signals.evidence: S_DOWNLOAD_RSP: ctrl_nxt.buf_err <= ctrl.buf_err or bus_rsp_i.err; S_DOWNLOAD_DONE checks ctrl.buf_err to invalidate and set host_rsp_o

signals.name: ctrl.buf_dir
signals.functionality: When set, forces the current request to be forwarded directly to the bus (bypass cache). It is set in IDLE based on address/amo/debug and cleared in next-state defaults.
signals.evidence: S_IDLE sets ctrl_nxt.buf_dir <= '1' when address in UC range or amo/debug; S_LOOKUP checks ctrl.buf_dir to set bus_req_o.stb

signals.name: ctrl.tag
signals.functionality: Holds the tag bits derived from the host address at lookup time and used to form addresses for downloads; loaded from ctrl_nxt.tag in the clocked update.
signals.evidence: S_LOOKUP sets ctrl_nxt.tag <= host_req_i.addr(...); S_DOWNLOAD_REQ uses ctrl.tag & ctrl.idx & ctrl.ofs for addresses

signals.name: ctrl.idx
signals.functionality: Stores the index bits of the address when a lookup occurs and is used with tag/ofs to form download addresses; updated from ctrl_nxt.idx and captured on clock edges.
signals.evidence: S_LOOKUP sets ctrl_nxt.idx <= host_req_i.addr(...); S_DOWNLOAD_REQ uses ctrl.idx in bus/cache addresses

signals.name: ctrl.ofs
signals.functionality: Tracks the current word offset inside a cache block during multi-beat downloads; incremented in S_DOWNLOAD_RSP when a bus beat completes and captured across cycles.
signals.evidence: S_DOWNLOAD_RSP increments ctrl_nxt.ofs <= std_ulogic_vector(unsigned(ctrl.ofs) + 1) on bus_rsp_i.ack

signals.name: ctrl_nxt
signals.functionality: Combinational next-state record computed by ctrl_engine_comb from current ctrl, host_req_i, cache_i and bus_rsp_i; then captured into ctrl on clk_i.
signals.evidence: ctrl_engine_comb assigns defaults to ctrl_nxt.* and modifies them in state case; ctrl captures ctrl_nxt on rising_edge(clk_i)

signals.name: ctrl_nxt.state
signals.functionality: Combinationally computed successor state of the controller FSM based on current ctrl, host_req_i, cache_i and bus_rsp_i; written in every case branch and then captured into ctrl.state on clock edge.
signals.evidence: ctrl_engine_comb sets ctrl_nxt.state <= ... in case ctrl.state branches; ctrl <= ctrl_nxt in clocked process

signals.name: ctrl_nxt.buf_req
signals.functionality: Combinational next value for buf_req: set from ctrl.buf_req or host_req_i.stb and cleared in lookup; captured to ctrl.buf_req on clock edge.
signals.evidence: ctrl_nxt.buf_req <= ctrl.buf_req or host_req_i.stb default; cleared in S_LOOKUP; captured into ctrl.buf_req on clock

signals.name: ctrl_nxt.buf_sync
signals.functionality: Combinational next value for buf_sync built from previous buf_sync or host_req_i.fence; cleared on performing a clear and captured to ctrl on clock edge.
signals.evidence: ctrl_nxt.buf_sync <= ctrl.buf_sync or host_req_i.fence default; S_CLEAR clears ctrl_nxt.buf_sync

signals.name: ctrl_nxt.buf_err
signals.functionality: Combinational accumulator for bus error during download; receives current ctrl.buf_err ORed with bus_rsp_i.err in S_DOWNLOAD_RSP and is then captured into ctrl.buf_err.
signals.evidence: S_DOWNLOAD_RSP: ctrl_nxt.buf_err <= ctrl.buf_err or bus_rsp_i.err; captured into ctrl.buf_err

signals.name: ctrl_nxt.buf_dir
signals.functionality: Combinational next value for buf_dir: default cleared on entry then set in S_IDLE if address/amo/debug conditions apply; captured to ctrl.buf_dir on clock edge.
signals.evidence: S_IDLE sets ctrl_nxt.buf_dir <= '1' when unsigned(host_req_i.addr(31 downto 28)) >= unsigned(UC_BEGIN) or host_req_i.amo/debug

signals.name: ctrl_nxt.tag
signals.functionality: Combinationally derived tag bits from host_req_i.addr in S_LOOKUP and preserved otherwise; captured into ctrl.tag on clock edge for later downloads.
signals.evidence: S_LOOKUP sets ctrl_nxt.tag <= host_req_i.addr(31 downto 32-tag_size_c); captured into ctrl.tag on rising_edge(clk_i)

signals.name: ctrl_nxt.idx
signals.functionality: Combinationally derived index bits from host_req_i.addr in S_LOOKUP and captured to ctrl.idx for download/address formation.
signals.evidence: S_LOOKUP sets ctrl_nxt.idx <= host_req_i.addr(...) ; captured into ctrl.idx

signals.name: ctrl_nxt.ofs
signals.functionality: Combinationally set to zero on lookup start and incremented across download responses; captured into ctrl.ofs as the download beat counter.
signals.evidence: S_LOOKUP sets ctrl_nxt.ofs <= (others => '0'); S_DOWNLOAD_RSP increments ctrl_nxt.ofs when bus_rsp_i.ack = '1'

signals.name: valid_mem
signals.functionality: Holds NUM_BLOCKS valid bits updated on clock: cleared by rstn_i/ clr_i, cleared per-index by inv_i, and set per-index by new_i; its selected bit is read into valid_mem_rd.
signals.evidence: status_memory assigns valid_mem <= (others=>'0') and indexed writes valid_mem(to_integer(unsigned(acc_idx))) <= '0'/'1'.

signals.name: valid_mem_rd
signals.functionality: Captures the valid_mem bit indexed by acc_idx at clock edge and provides that single-bit to the hit comparator and external logic.
signals.evidence: status_memory: valid_mem_rd <= valid_mem(to_integer(unsigned(acc_idx))) at rising_edge(clk_i).

signals.name: tag_mem
signals.functionality: Stores tag vectors per index; on new_i at a clock edge the tag at acc_idx is written from acc_tag, and tag entries are read into tag_mem_rd for hit comparison.
signals.evidence: tag_memory: if (new_i='1') then tag_mem(to_integer(unsigned(acc_idx))) <= acc_tag; tag_mem_rd <= tag_mem(...).

signals.name: tag_mem_rd
signals.functionality: Captures the tag_mem entry indexed by acc_idx on clock edge and provides the stored tag for the hit comparator.
signals.evidence: tag_memory: tag_mem_rd <= tag_mem(to_integer(unsigned(acc_idx))) inside rising_edge(clk_i).

signals.name: data_mem_b0
signals.functionality: Array of stored lowest-order bytes; on enabled writes stores wdata_i(7 downto 0) at acc_adr index and supplies that byte to rdata_o(7 downto 0) on read (clocked).
signals.evidence: data_memory: if (we_i(0)='1') then data_mem_b0(to_integer(unsigned(acc_adr))) <= wdata_i(7 downto 0); rdata_o(7 downto 0) <= data_mem_b0(...).

signals.name: data_mem_b1
signals.functionality: Array of stored second bytes; on enabled writes stores wdata_i(15 downto 8) at acc_adr index and supplies that byte to rdata_o(15 downto 8) on read (clocked).
signals.evidence: data_memory: if (we_i(1)='1') then data_mem_b1(to_integer(unsigned(acc_adr))) <= wdata_i(15 downto 8); rdata_o(15 downto 8) <= data_mem_b1(...).

signals.name: data_mem_b2
signals.functionality: Array of stored third bytes; on enabled writes stores wdata_i(23 downto 16) at acc_adr index and supplies that byte to rdata_o(23 downto 16) on read (clocked).
signals.evidence: data_memory: if (we_i(2)='1') then data_mem_b2(to_integer(unsigned(acc_adr))) <= wdata_i(23 downto 16); rdata_o(23 downto 16) <= data_mem_b2(...).

signals.name: data_mem_b3
signals.functionality: Array of stored highest-order bytes; on enabled writes stores wdata_i(31 downto 24) at acc_adr index and supplies that byte to rdata_o(31 downto 24) on read (clocked).
signals.evidence: data_memory: if (we_i(3)='1') then data_mem_b3(to_integer(unsigned(acc_adr))) <= wdata_i(31 downto 24); rdata_o(31 downto 24) <= data_mem_b3(...).

signals.name: acc_tag
signals.functionality: Derives the tag slice from addr_i and provides it to tag writes and the hit comparator; assigned combinationally from addr_i slices.
role: SOURCES tag write and hit comparator
signals.evidence: Concurrent: acc_tag <= addr_i(31 downto 31-(tag_size_c-1)); used in tag_mem write and hit compare.

signals.name: acc_idx
signals.functionality: Derives index bits from addr_i, selects entries in tag and valid memories and participates in acc_adr formation via concatenation with acc_off.
role: SELECTS entries of tag and valid memories
signals.evidence: acc_idx <= addr_i(...); used as to_integer(unsigned(acc_idx)) for indexing valid_mem and tag_mem and concatenated into acc_adr.

signals.name: acc_off
signals.functionality: Derives the offset bits from addr_i and is concatenated with acc_idx to form acc_adr for byte addressing of data memories.
signals.evidence: acc_off <= addr_i(2+(offset_size_c-1) downto 2); then acc_adr <= acc_idx & acc_off.

signals.name: acc_adr
signals.functionality: Concatenates acc_idx and acc_off to form a combined address used to index the byte arrays data_mem_b0..b3 for reads and writes.
role: SELECTS entries in data byte memories
signals.evidence: acc_adr <= acc_idx & acc_off; used as index to data_mem_b0..b3 in data_memory (to_integer(unsigned(acc_adr))).
